meta.title: User Tagging: refused for a user without the Tenant Admin role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role on the specified Growth tenant
Use User Tagging to tag users and verify that Procol refuses the action or does not offer it
Repeat the User Tagging action as a Tenant Admin and compare that it is available
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Tenant Admin role on the specified Growth tenant; Use User Tagging to tag users and verify that Procol refuses the action or does not offer it; Repeat the User Tagging action as a Tenant Admin and compare that it is available

args.need: sign in as the non-Tenant Admin user and the Tenant Admin on the same Growth tenant, use User Tagging to tag users in each session, and compare whether the action is refused or unavailable for the non-admin but available to the Tenant Admin
